And, very soon, Bakingo will be coming up with its mobile app that will take your experience to another level. Excited? Well, we are as much as you! Bakingo also provides online delivery options for best-selling cakes and desserts, so that you do not have to worry about its dispatch. Bakingo takes care of everything!

Bakingo provides three-delivery options, i.e., same-day, midnight, and instant. Our delivery services are prompt and timely across all the seven Indian cities. If you go with our instant delivery of valentine cakes, the cake will reach the designated doorstep within three hours of the order placed. Midnight delivery guarantees the arrival of the cake at midnight. If you choose the same-day delivery, Bakingo will deliver the cake on the selected date and time.
